name: fr3_dual
description: Two FR3s side by side, bolted down once placed; left and right are the arms' own. The left is 192.168.11.102 -- the arm registered to the world as fr3_base (it was called 'right' until 10-26) -- and the new 192.168.1.210 went in to its right (B1). Datasets stay in fr3_base, now the left arm's base; the right arm's targets reach its base through fr3_base -> fr3_base_right (B3, arm-arm ball) and, for absolute replay, the world edges (B4). Until that edge exists the graph has no fr3_base_right node, so everything right is refused with that reason. 10-26 both bases were moved and neither is in its final place: fr3_base's world edge is stale until it is registered again.

fr3_base.definition: libfranka O frame of the left FR3 (192.168.11.102) at its current mount

fr3_base_right.definition: libfranka O frame of the right FR3 (192.168.1.210) at its mount
